item.title: How much does custom clamshell packaging cost?
item.description: Real factory prices for custom PET clamshells, what tooling costs, and how freight, tariffs and inspection change the landed cost per piece — from actual production orders.

item.title: Clamshell vs. blister packaging: which is right for your product?
item.description: Clamshells and blister cards both put your product on display — but they differ in cost, equipment, security and branding. Here's how to choose, with real cost drivers.

item.title: DDP shipping from China for packaging orders
item.description: What DDP (delivered duty paid) shipping from China includes, what it really costs per container, how long it takes, and why it's the safest way to import packaging.

item.title: Your domestic packaging supplier probably buys from China
item.description: Many U.S. packaging distributors resell clamshells and boxes made overseas, with a markup. Here's how to tell, what it costs you, and when going factory-direct makes sense.

item.title: Pre-shipment inspection in China: what it costs and what to check
item.description: How third-party pre-shipment inspection works for packaging orders made in China, what it costs (about $330–$750 per visit), and the checklist we use for boxes and clamshells.

item.title: How much do custom rigid boxes cost?
item.description: Real factory prices for custom magnetic and rigid boxes at 1,500 to 40,000+ units, what drives the price, and how freight and duties change your landed cost per box.
